plt1-figure.def: The whole matplotlib canvas: its size, background and the file it is saved to. Holds one or more axes.

plt1-axes.def: One plotting area inside a figure, with its own x-axis, y-axis, ticks, labels, title and data. Not the plural of axis.

plt1-colormap.def: A rule mapping numbers to colours, e.g. viridis; used by scatter(c=...) and imshow.

plt1-hist.def: Bars counting how many values fall in each of a set of equal-width bins; shows the shape of one variable.

plt1-boxplot.def: A five-number summary: box from the 25th to 75th percentile, median line, whiskers to 1.5 box-lengths, outliers as points.

plt1-heatmap.def: A picture of a 2-D array where colour encodes each cell's value (ax.imshow).
